d: Customers of Punjab National Bank in Greater Noida have alleged that around Rs 35 crore vanished from their savings accounts and fixed deposits at a branch in the Aichhar area, with many claiming they neither received any transaction alerts nor signed any documents authorizing the transfers. The missing funds include large compensation amounts received by farmers and land owners for projects such as Jewar Airport, leaving families in distress after discovering drastically reduced balances. Several bank employees including the branch manager have been suspended while police have registered…
